$comment: THE BLESSED ENGINE VERSIONS: which version of each upstream agent program a sandbox takes by default.
Every sandbox on the `blessed` channel reads this file (raw.githubusercontent.com, hourly, ETag'd), so a
version blessed by a commit here reaches the whole fleet within the hour — no image, no release. That is
the point of the file: an engine's version stopped being a property of the sandbox image.
An owner who would rather have upstream's newest without waiting for this list sets that engine's channel
to `latest` on the Environment card; one debugging a regression pins a version there instead.
`blessed` must be a version this repository's own suite has run against, which is what the CI check in
_tools/checks/engines-blessed.mjs enforces against the pins in pnpm-workspace.yaml and the packs.
`minimum` is advisory and records a floor the provider itself enforces, so a card can explain a refusal.

claude.notes: npm @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk; ships Claude Code 2.1.257, which is the version the API states its floors in.

cursor.notes: npm @cursor/sdk. Never baked into a published image: its licence grants no redistribution.

opencode.notes: npm opencode-ai, the runtime behind Grok turns.

translator.notes: CLIProxyAPI GitHub release, the subscription translator behind Gemini, Kimi and ChatGPT turns.
